summary: ONE Gas, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $375 million offering of 5.45% senior unsecured notes due 2036, priced at 99.675% of par with an underwriting discount of 0.650%. The notes mature September 1, 2036, pay interest semi-annually, and are redeemable at the issuer's option. They will be delivered in book-entry form via DTC on August 13, 2026. Joint book-running managers include BofA Securities, RBC Capital Markets, and Truist Securities. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction with no special-situation characteristics.
